payload.friendly_name: Step enhancements and prompt fragments in the charter service
payload.purpose_context: ADR-0066 lets a step enhancement add prompt fragments into named slots of a mission step's prompt. The contracts landed in #425; the service still drops step enhancements, never checks slots or fragments, and has no way to read the prompt a step really gets. This mission closes that gap (#424, #428) so packs such as open-packs' spdd pack can ship their guidance as fragments.
payload.purpose_tldr: The charter service holds step enhancements and their prompt fragments, checks them, and serves the effective step prompt.

payload.question: Is the Mission scope the research brief's #424+#428 slices (WP-A..WP-F) with operator rulings D1-D22 as recommended?

options: confirm d8: refuse whatever the activation
amend ADR-0066: refuse only when active, warn otherwise
payload.question: ADR-0066 d8 says compose checks run 'whatever the activation': does an INACTIVE step enhancement whose slot a prompt override dropped refuse every composing read (500), or only an active one (warn otherwise)?

options: steps are always enhanceable (d7 locked-target rule vacuous for steps until policies can name actions)
payload.question: Does a step (action:<type>/<step>) inherit its mission type's mutability level, so a locked mission type refuses a step enhancement (ADR-0066 d7)? Policies cannot name an action today.

payload.final_answer: accept recommendations: research brief section 6 D1-D22 as recommended (operator, relayed by the orchestrator 2026-11-09 09:04 UTC; corroborated by #431-#435 filed from the operator's account). D12 refuse an empty enhancement. D23 undecided (unparented). D13 and D14 Q2 had no recommendation and are open.

payload.rationale: No squad recommendation in research brief section 6, so not covered by the operator's 'accept recommendations'. Escalated to the operator 2026-11-09. Blocks only WP-D (compose checks), which starts after PR C merges (D2).

payload.final_answer: (B) refuse only when active: amend ADR-0066 d8 with a dated annotation; an inactive enhancement whose slot the prompt in force dropped does not refuse (operator, interview 2026-11-09)

(A) a step inherits its mission type's mutability level; an enhancement onto a locked step is refused per the C21 precedent: 500 pack_unreadable on reads, 422 override_not_permitted (description broadened, no new enum value) at registration (operator, interview 2026-11-09)
